title: allium jesdianum subsp. angustitepalum
intro: Allium jesdianum subsp. angustitepalum, commonly known as the narrow-petaled ornamental onion, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Allium jesdianum subsp. angustitepalum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and possess antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sulfur compounds, such as allicin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
